verdict.rationale: Fastmail's evidence shows only a standards-based JMAP API, search, and general mail features — there is no documented AI assistant, natural-language Q&A layer, or grounded cross-inbox/calendar reasoning capability shipped by Fastmail itself. The JMAP API could theoretically be used by a third-party assistant, but no such first-party or hands-on evidence of grounded inbox+calendar Q&A exists in the pack.
